scenario: close('abandoned') with a turn genuinely in flight
how: sent a turn shelling out to `sleep 40`, waited 9s, closed as abandoned

provenance.detail: observation channel lost; turn state unobservable
the child may still be running; this asserts nothing about the turn

note: Codex hook trust had to be seeded first, in a plain repository: in a linked worktree Codex resolves its project config from the MAIN worktree, so the sidecar landed in one directory while trust was recorded for another.
